decisionGuide.intent: Trigger an in-place action versus navigate to another location.
decisionGuide.rule: Use Button for actions. Use Link for navigation.

decisionGuide.intent: Collect free-form text versus choose from known values.
decisionGuide.rule: Use Input for free-form text, Select for a known non-editable option set, and Combobox when editable/searchable text is part of option selection.

decisionGuide.intent: Choose from a small option set that should remain visible.
decisionGuide.rule: Use Radio for form choice semantics. Use SegmentedButton for compact mutually exclusive view/action modes.

decisionGuide.intent: Arrange content vertically, horizontally, generically with flex, in two dimensions, overlapped, or positioned.
decisionGuide.rule: Prefer Column for vertical sequences, Row for horizontal sequences, Grid for two-dimensional layout, Stack for overlap, Absolute for positioned children, and Flex only when the axis is genuinely generic or dynamic.
Do not use View for normal application layout. View is the component-author primitive and the View documentation demo exception.

decisionGuide.intent: Render tabular data with or without data-grid behavior.
decisionGuide.rule: Use Table for semantic tabular composition. Use DataGrid when sorting, resizing, selection, or virtualization is required.

decisionGuide.intent: Choose between hint, anchored interactive surface, dialog, drawer, or menu.
decisionGuide.rule: Use ToolTip for brief non-interactive hints, Popover for anchored interactive content, Dialog for a focused dialog surface, Drawer for edge-attached panels, and Menu for command/menu navigation semantics.

decisionGuide.intent: Keep exiting content mounted while exit motion completes.
decisionGuide.rule: Use Presence for enter/exit mount lifecycle. Do not build a parallel exit-presence mechanism.

decisionGuide.intent: Associate labels, descriptions, errors, fields, fieldsets, and legends.
decisionGuide.rule: Use Weave form composition instead of manually duplicating label/description/error association logic.

View.intent: Low-level public construction primitive for component authors and framework infrastructure.
avoidWhen: examples other than the View demo

Input.intent: Single-line or multiline free-form native text input.
avoidWhen: the user must choose only from known options

Select.intent: Single-value selection from a known option set without editable text entry.
preferWhen: arbitrary text must not be entered
avoidWhen: searchable editable text is part of the interaction

Combobox.intent: Searchable/editable single-value listbox that combines text input with option selection.
preferWhen: users search a known option set
avoidWhen: a simple non-editable known option set is sufficient

preferWhen: a small option set should remain visible

SegmentedButton.intent: Compact mutually exclusive segmented actions or modes.
preferWhen: switching a small set of modes or views
avoidWhen: the control is primarily a form field choice
the intent is an in-place action

Flex.intent: Generic flex layout when Row or Column would not express the intended axis clearly.
avoidWhen: a fixed vertical sequence can use Column
a fixed horizontal sequence can use Row

preferWhen: children intentionally occupy the same grid area or overlap

Table.intent: Semantic tabular content composed from public table subcomponents.
avoidWhen: sorting, resizing, selection, or virtualization is required

DataGrid.intent: Interactive data table with data-grid behaviors.

Dialog.intent: Focused dialog surface, modal or non-modal according to its API.

Menu.intent: Menu/command surface with menu-item keyboard semantics.

Presence.intent: Enter/exit mount lifecycle orchestration without producing its own DOM.
preferWhen: exit content must remain mounted until exit motion completes
